sections.text: مقدمة

يسرد هذا المستند 
فحص المعدات I1، والذي يجب إجراؤه كل ستة أشهر 
تمت الإشارة إليه بواسطة M6 في مقطع العنوان

This document outlines the testing of the AC Generator Package, Gas Generator Package, and 
Accessories Package fire extinguisher system, which 
contain two cylinders each of these are connected by manifolds and pipe work to 
discharge nozzles in the compartments.

Three lamp system 
state indicators, together with break glass manual operation units are also 
mounted on the outside of the compartment adjacent to each compartment access 
door

The first draft 
initiated and prepared by eng. Wael Taha Yousef and reviewed, tested by eng. 
Entsar Ahmed Omar, and approved by eng. Sawsan El lethey: Port Said Plant 
director.

This document accepted by eng. Samir Abd El Gilil; 
 EDEPC inspection & quality control general director, MPIS coordinator, and certified by accountant Mahmoud Soliman: 
 EDEPC admin & financial inspection & quality control's general director, and 
 supervisor of inspection & quality control's head sector.
احتياطات السلامة

A work permit must be issued, the qualified 
 maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work 
 area is required.

sections.text: العمل المراد تنفيذه

Manual 
Test
Put the system on manual position.
Disconnect power supply of the system.
Disconnect all connection for solenoid.
قم بتوصيل مصدر الطاقة للنظام.

By shorting across the detection circuit to 
 simulate fire detector.

Actuation operates a red Halon Released lamp at 
 the control panel.
Operates an audible alarm.

Illuminate the fire warning lamps mounted on the 
 outside of the compartment adjacent to each compartment access door.
